title: Easy To Follow 30 Minute Dance Workout View From The Back (Salsa, Bachata, Merengue, Mambo And More)

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces a dance style, explains which foot to start on, and counts out loud while demonstrating the steps facing away from the camera. She leads through basic steps, side steps, and turns in repetitive sequences before transitioning to the next dance style.
method.signature: The teacher records the entire workout facing away from the camera, allowing learners to follow along directly without mirroring the left and right sides.

practices.what: The teacher explains she will face away from the camera so it is easier to follow along.
The teacher introduces the first dance style, merengue, and breaks down the marching and stepping pattern.
The teacher repeats the march and walk sequence multiple times before adding a side step.
The teacher transitions to the next dance style, mambo, and breaks down the basic step starting on the left foot.
The teacher introduces the cha-cha, counting out the rhythmic steps and side movements.
The teacher introduces the samba, starting with side basics and moving into the whisk and botafogo steps.

beliefs.belief: The teacher believes that facing away from the learner makes it easier for them to follow along.

moments.says: The teacher explains that they will face away from the learner to make it easier to follow along.
The teacher announces they are going to walk forward and then back, preparing the learner for the upcoming movement.
The teacher tells the learner they are going to do a full basic to the side for four counts and then turn.
The teacher tells the learner they did a good job.
The teacher reminds the learner to use their arms.
The teacher tells the learner they are doing very good and to keep going.
The teacher tells the learner they are doing very good.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable and encouraged to keep dancing.

struggles.theme: Lacking coordination or having two left feet
Mobility issues or pain from past injuries

clicked.theme: Facing away from the camera makes following along much easier

requests.theme: Asking for more videos and more complicated routines

meant.theme: Helped with weight loss and staying active while homebound
Elevated mood and helped relieve depression or stress

method.limits: Audio quality and music tracks are not fully detailed, and the video cuts off before showing any post-lesson cooldown or stretch.
